measurements.note: Corrected. The TDS prints "ISO 11357 80°C"; the standard number and the value had been read as one number, 1135780. Flagged physically implausible: the sheet prints a glass transition of 80 °C for an ABS, whose styrene-acrylonitrile phase goes glassy near 105 °C; nothing on the sheet (an ESD grade, no plasticiser declared) moves it 25 °C. Kept as printed; it backs nothing.

measurements.note: Quarantined: the sheet pairs Method A with 0.45 MPa and Method B with 1.80 MPa (ISO 75-2 defines A as 1.80 and B as 0.45), and by its stated loads the 1.80 MPa value (75 °C) would exceed the 0.45 MPa value (70 °C), which cannot be. Which value belongs to which load is unresolved.
